name: GreptimeDB Open-Source Observability Database
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed open-source core for self-hosted metrics, logs and traces storage and SQL/PromQL querying; standalone or distributed deployment without software license fees.
watch_out: You operate and pay for compute, object storage, networking, backups and any external observability ingestion infrastructure. GreptimeDB Enterprise features (including automated repartitioning, read replicas and enterprise governance) are separately licensed; Greptime Cloud pricing is separate.
